subject: Fix compilation warning in KeySpace_ServerEventCallback and add CFLAGS=-Werror flag for module CI (#12786)
reason: The change is a CI/build change plus a cosmetic fix in a test module: it adds CFLAGS=-Werror to the module-API test steps in the GitHub workflows and fixes a RedisModule_Log format specifier (%ld -> %llu with a cast) in tests/modules/postnotifications.c. No server code, command reply, replication, persistence or module-API behaviour changes; the only runtime effect is the formatting of a warning log line inside a test module, on a branch for unexpected subevents. There is nothing a fuzzer scenario could observe differing between the two builds.
